consideredButRetained.reason: Historical development and the subsequent lone-discoverer inference are distinct readable moves. Combining them would increase density without improving the task.
Dramatic content, adaptation and grammatical form have different tasks. The opening shipwreck language is an actual stage/text experience, not a redundant plot summary to delete mechanically.

Physical historical Houdini material and born-digital Library of Congress access are distinct actual institutions and record types. A combined fabricated collection would erase their factual boundary.
The return to relationships and meaning closes the preservation task after the two teaching arrangements; retained as a useful arc rather than deleting every unannotated ending.
